_readme: TRA-4261 — the repo-resident deploy hold read by scripts/render-redeploy.mjs. See ops/README-deploy-hold.md for the shape and the rules. This file is on the TIP, so it ships with whatever ships and is discoverable by `git log ops/deploy-hold.json` and by grep — not only by whoever happened to read a ticket thread. An empty `holds` array is the cleared state; DELETING the file is also the cleared state. Every gate in render-redeploy.mjs fails CLOSED, and so does this one: an unparseable file or a hold missing a required field REFUSES, it does not degrade to allowed. TRA-4262: `emits` is a SNAPSHOT OF A MOVING TIP — this script ships the tip, never a pin, so every hold must stamp the `enumeratedTip` its `emits` was taken against (a required field), and the enumeration is RE-TAKEN at clear time by the clearer. `git log <enumeratedTip>..origin/main` is the whole check.

holds.openedBy: LeadDev (d3355d6d) — raised by CEO on TRA-4261, off TRA-4217
holds.reason: Deploying bqb1 right now RUNS THE TRA-4218 HEAL ON THREE OPEN REAL-MONEY ROWS. e1dbf341 is already an ancestor of origin/main and this script ships the TIP, not a pin (TRA-3888: a pinned --commit ages, drop it, ship the tip), so a deploy taken for any UNRELATED reason performs that migration on live money in production Tradier ***0154. The heal is not a code path that waits to be called: it runs at snapshot import, i.e. at boot, in OptionsAccount.importSnapshot (packages/server/src/options-account.ts, the TRA-4218 block). Whether that migration should run tonight is a board decision and it is NOT this gate's to make — it is the pending human_only card on TRA-4217 (`101f5a22` as of 2026-09-01T20:10Z; the previously cited `438ed4c5` EXPIRED UNANSWERED at 19:51:11Z — re-derive the live id, see clearedBy). This hold exists so that the decision is TAKEN rather than inherited by whoever deploys next.
emits: e1dbf341ae28c27159f884ffd0f21a568626f751 (TRA-4218) boots into OptionsAccount.importSnapshot and, for every open row whose exitErrorReason matches TRANSPORT_STRANDED_REASON_RE (5xx / 429 / 408 / fetch failure), DELETES closeRejectCount.
On the same rows it DELETES exitBreakerTrip where exitBreakerTrip.breaker === 'close_reject' (TRA-4225), which un-latches the close-reject breaker that is presently refusing the exits.

It then RE-ARMS through one backoff step: exitTransportFailCount = 1 and exitRetryNotBeforeMs = now + exitTransportBackoffMs(1). After that step expires the exit path is live again, so this is a change that can PLACE ORDERS, not merely a change to a counter.

Population as measured on 2026-08-31: ALL THREE open real-money OTM rows in production Tradier account ***0154, two of them under a BREACHED stop. There is no smaller blast radius available — the heal is unconditional on the rows that match.

RE-ENUMERATED 2026-09-01T15:15Z against 8061bbf6 (TRA-4262). The four rows above were enumerated at 14:32Z against 4e0f4438 and were ALREADY INCOMPLETE when written: this script ships the tip, so everything below rides in the same box. THE REST OF THIS LIST IS NOT PART OF THE TRA-4218 DECISION — it is what else is in the box, which is what the previous enumeration silently omitted.

77047ea0 (TRA-4255) SHIPS SERVER BYTES: packages/server/src/rv-scan-telemetry.ts +223, observability/health-routes.ts +31. Read-only instrument by construction — no admission gate, threshold or flag is touched, and it opens no order. NOT INERT FOR READERS: GET /api/health/rv-scan gains paths[].admissibility and a FIFTH verdict, `armed_admitting_nothing`, reachable only from what previously read `scanning`. Anything grading that route on the string `scanning` (a routine, a soak grader, a dashboard) can flip verdict on this deploy with no change in trading behaviour. Recorded here as production-byte-relevant-but-benign FOR MONEY, not benign for graders.

8061bbf6 (TRA-4154) SHIPS SERVER BYTES: packages/server/src/live-enforce-gate-ledger.ts +239, observability/health-routes.ts (one note string). Observability only — no order path, no gate tightened, no new rejection; barR, the [0.50,0.55) band, otmArmed, row size, the 2-row cap and the entry windows are untouched. It is a PROJECTION of rows apply() already folded (byDay has always been keyed by ET day), so it counts nothing new at any call site. Cost measured as shipped: the /api/health/live-enforce-gates payload grows ~92 KB (~42 KB → ~134 KB) from retained.byGate[].byEtDay[]. Recorded here as production-byte-relevant-but-benign.

7aba5654 (TRA-4261) and the TRA-4262 commit that added this line touch ops/ and scripts/ ONLY — no server byte, nothing in packages/. They change what render-redeploy.mjs refuses, not what the box runs.

RE-ENUMERATED 2026-09-01T15:40Z against 197912db, by the author of the push that staled the 15:15Z list. Three commits landed after 8061bbf6 (2bb9df2 TRA-4262, 7dcb834 TRA-4264, 197912d TRA-4258); `git diff --name-only 8061bbf6..197912db -- packages/` outside tests is exactly three files, enumerated below. This is the mechanism TRA-4262 filed working as intended on its first real push: the previous list was correct when written and wrong 25 minutes later, and nothing but this re-take would have said so.

7dcb8342 (TRA-4264) SHIPS SERVER BYTES: packages/server/src/index.ts +54, ENTRY/catch logging on the two `/api/health/tradier-sandbox/*` smoke routes ONLY. Log statements and a generated `reqId` — no order path, no gate, no threshold, and the routes it touches are SANDBOX (Tradier sandbox creds), not production ***0154. NOT INERT FOR READERS: the Render tape gains markers `sandbox-equity-smoke-entry` / `-complete` / `-failed`, so anything grading smoke outcomes on log SILENCE flips meaning on this deploy. Recorded as production-byte-relevant-but-benign FOR MONEY, not benign for graders.

197912db (TRA-4258) SHIPS SERVER BYTES: packages/server/src/ratification-stamp.ts +62, observability/health-routes.ts +51 (one new payload key and one note string). Read-only ATTESTATION and structurally incapable of gating: ratification-stamp.ts has exactly ONE importer in the tree, the health route — no admission path, arm/disarm or block reason can reach it. `arm.costBar.bar` and `arm.costBar.edge.otmCells` are asserted byte-identical across unstamped/match/mismatch. The cost-gate margin itself is UNTOUCHED (0.10R, board-ratified on card 10fd2af1, the floor per TRA-4168). Two shared-helper changes are default-preserving: `polarity` defaults to `cap`, so the two existing notional/aggregate cap stamps render bit-identically, and `toleranceAbs` defaults to 0, which is exactly the `===` it replaced. NOT INERT FOR READERS: `/api/health/live-enforce-gates` gains `arm.costBar.ratification` and its `note` grows one paragraph. Recorded as production-byte-relevant-but-benign.
759953d3 (TRA-4258) SHIPS NO SERVER BYTE: `git diff --numstat 197912db..759953d3 -- packages/` is EMPTY. It edits ops/deploy-hold.json only — the previous re-enumeration itself. Cannot reach the box.

abfabb90 (TRA-4260) SHIPS SERVER BYTES: broker-submit-census.ts +101/-12, tradier-smart-close.ts +161/-7, signal-engine.ts +67/-0, index.ts +23/-1. tradier-smart-close.ts is a REAL CLOSE PATH and this is the one entry on this list that touches one, so it is enumerated at the line level rather than by summary. The change is ADDITIVE INSTRUMENTATION: a `submittedOrders` counter, a `failure` discriminant (`broker_rejected` | `submit_threw` | `transport_fault`) on the `rejected` variant, and a pure `smartSellCloseCensusEvents()` mapping outcome -> census events. Every DELETED line in that file is a type-union declaration being widened; not one is a statement. No order is submitted, no limit price is computed, and no retry or abort branch is taken that was not taken before — the close path decides exactly what it decided, and now says what it decided. NOT INERT FOR READERS: /api/health/options-live close-census counters that read 0 for the imported-close route were a HOLE, and after this deploy they are a measurement, so any grade resting on those zeros flips meaning. Recorded as production-byte-relevant, non-behavioral for order flow.

a6188cd8 (TRA-3553) SHIPS SERVER BYTES: options-account.ts +70/-9, signal-engine.ts +26/-1, index.ts +25/-1. PUBLICATION ONLY. Adds `foldImportProvenanceCensuses()` (a pure sum over per-book counters, plus `blind`), a `SignalEngine.getImportProvenanceCensus()` read-side fold over both env buckets, and publishes `importProvenance` on /api/health/options-live. The -9 in options-account.ts is an inline return type replaced by the named `ImportProvenanceCensus`; the -1s are the import lines being extended. It reads counters that 4cac8b70 has already been incrementing on this box since 2026-08-13 — no counter is written, no admission path, arm, threshold or exit branch is reachable from any of it, and nothing under the TRA-4218 heal is touched. NOT INERT FOR READERS: the route gains `importProvenance`, whose `blind: true` says the imported cohort is EMPTY (unmeasured), NOT clean — read that field before its counters.

RE-ENUMERATED 2026-09-01T20:10Z against 87d66235, from the TRA-4258 monitor wake — i.e. by a reader who came back for the freeze lift, NOT by the author of the intervening pushes. Four commits landed after a6188cd8 (13f0f41 TRA-3553, 10c69a7 TRA-3980, 82c5a54 TRA-4158, 87d6623 TRA-4158). `git diff --numstat a6188cd8..87d66235 -- packages/` is exactly TWO files and both belong to 87d6623; the other three touch ops/, scripts/, evidence/ and reports/ ONLY and cannot reach the box.

87d66235 (TRA-4158) SHIPS SERVER BYTES: packages/server/src/event-loop-watchdog.ts +49/-6 (plus a new .test.ts, which does not ship). LOG CLASSIFICATION ONLY. It extracts `isUnexplainedDeath()` and moves the `livenessIntervalMs` resolution above the boot-classification block, so the breadcrumb gap is compared against the heartbeat interval that produced it (15s default, x2 slack) instead of a hard-coded 5s. No trip threshold, no restart decision, no order path and no gate is touched — the watchdog trips on exactly the same conditions and restarts in exactly the same cases; only whether one `log.warn` line is emitted changes. NOT INERT FOR READERS, and in the SUPPRESSING direction: 'external kill (SIGKILL 137 / health-check SIGTERM) suspected' stops firing on graceful self-restarts that also wrote a trip breadcrumb (measured 14 of 28 deaths on bqb1, 2026-08-28..09-01). Anything counting that line on the Render tape reads a LOWER number after this deploy with no change in the underlying death rate. Recorded as production-byte-relevant-but-benign FOR MONEY, not benign for graders.

THIS LIST GOES STALE THE NEXT TIME ANYONE PUSHES. It describes 87d66235. Before clearing, run `git log 87d66235..origin/main` and re-enumerate — see clearedBy. render-redeploy.mjs prints the delta in its refusal (TRA-4262), but only for a deploy somebody actually attempts.

holds.clearedBy: The board answering the LIVE decision card on TRA-4217 — as of 2026-09-01T20:10Z that is `101f5a22` (pending, created 19:51:43Z), NOT `438ed4c5`, which EXPIRED UNANSWERED at 19:51:11Z. ⚠️ A CARD ID IN THIS FIELD AGES THE SAME WAY `emits` DOES: TRA-4217's card has been re-posted six times (5d195de5 cancelled, ef483f54/8614034c/438ed4c5/3f453050 expired, f13de3d5 cancelled) and each re-post is a NEW id, so re-derive the pending one from `GET /api/issues/9b7d7b6a-36de-438b-83de-199bc31b87b7/interactions` rather than trusting the literal here. THE CONDITION IS THE DECISION, NOT THE ID: the board must answer the `stock` question on the pending card. Note its options MOVED — the live card's CEO recommendation is now `close_open` (hand-close all 3 at the 09-02 open), with `deploy` (e1dbf341 heals the latch at import) as the alternative; the earlier card had `deploy` as the CEO-recommended route. If the board picks a non-deploy option, this hold does NOT auto-clear — the answer must say what happens to the heal, because the heal still runs at the next boot for ANY reason. TWO ACTS, BOTH REQUIRED IN THE CLEARING COMMIT (TRA-4262 — this script ships the TIP, so an authorization enumerated in advance is an authorization for a smaller box than the one that ships): (1) RE-ENUMERATE. Run `git log <enumeratedTip>..origin/main` and `git diff --name-only <enumeratedTip>..origin/main`. For every commit that lands after the CURRENT enumeratedTip (never a literal SHA copied from a past re-take — that is the staleness this field keeps re-acquiring), either EXTEND emits[] with what it emits, or state in the clearing commit message that the delta touches no server byte (nothing under packages/ outside tests) and why that is safe. `packages/**` outside tests is what ships to the box; `ops/`, `scripts/`, `docs/` do not. (2) CLEAR. Delete this entry in the SAME commit as the deploy carrier, so the hold, its final enumeration and its release are one reviewable diff. On `hold`: leave the entry, re-stamp enumeratedTip/enumeratedAt to whatever you just measured against, and say on TRA-4217 what the new condition is — a hold left standing on a stale enumeration is the defect TRA-4262 filed. Do NOT clear it because it is inconvenient — --override-hold exists for the genuine emergency, records itself, and now also names the staleness it is overriding.
